title: VP Sara wants relentless crackdown on illegal drugs
summary: “Dapat relentless talaga yung paghahabol sa ilegal na droga. Maraming problema ang nagsisimula sa iligal na droga… Kaya dapat kinokontrol , sinu-suppress at ginagawang almost zero ng gobyerno ang…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte said that she wanted a relentless campaign against illegal drugs.
According to a "24 Oras" report on Thursday, the vice president had an interview with former Communications undersecretary and pro-Duterte vlogger Mocha Uson, who asked about Oplan Tokhang.
Oplan Tokhang is the campaign of former president Rodrigo Duterte, Sara Duterte’s father. The campaign became synonymous with the bloodY drug war, which saw the deaths of at least 6,000 people.

“Dapat relentless talaga yung paghahabol sa ilegal na droga. Maraming problema ang nagsisimula sa iligal na droga… Kaya dapat kinokontrol , sinu-suppress at ginagawang almost zero ng gobyerno ang iligal na droga,” Sara Duterte said.
(The pursuit of illegal drugs should be relentless. There are a lot of problems that start from illegal drugs… Illegal drugs should be controlled, suppressed and made almost zero by the government.)
The fight against illegal drugs was one of the flagship projects of former president Duterte. However, it was widely criticized by both local and international human rights groups.

Rodrigo Duterte is now detained in The Hague, Netherlands, and is awaiting trial before the International Criminal Court for crimes against humanity in relation to the drug war. —Jean Mangaluz/LDF, GMA News
